_meta.description: General DevOps procedures for Power Pages Enhanced Data Model portals. Platform knowledge — not project-specific. Consumed by agents and scripts.
_meta.principle: Never guess when the trail to a successful resolution has already been discovered.

setTablePermission.description: Create or update a table permission with role links that the portal runtime actually enforces.

primary.method: New-Record to mspp_entitypermissions + PATCH powerpagecomponent content JSON with adx_entitypermission_webrole array

steps.description: POST to mspp_entitypermissions. This also creates a powerpagecomponent type=18 record with the same ID.
steps.notes: The mspp_entitypermissions record and powerpagecomponent type=18 record share the same GUID.

steps.description: PATCH the powerpagecomponent content JSON to include adx_entitypermission_webrole array. This is the CRITICAL step — without it the portal returns 403.
steps.notes: The portal runtime reads role links from this JSON, NOT from the mspp_entitypermission_webrole intersection table.

fallbacks.method: DELETE the mspp_entitypermission, then re-CREATE with correct values. The powerpagecomponent is auto-recreated.
steps: Read current role links from content JSON
PATCH new powerpagecomponent content JSON with role links
fallbacks.notes: WARNING: After deleting/recreating ANY permission, verify ALL other permissions still have their role links. See engineering journal section 20.

fallbacks.method: Create the powerpagecomponent type=18 record directly with full content JSON including roles.
steps: New-Record -setName 'powerpagecomponents' with powerpagecomponenttype=18, content JSON with all fields + adx_entitypermission_webrole array, powerpagesiteid bind
fallbacks.notes: Not fully tested. The mspp_entitypermissions view may not pick it up.

primary.description: Call /_api/{entitySet} from an authenticated portal session. 200 = working, 403 = not enforced.

secondary.description: GET powerpagecomponents({id}), parse content JSON, verify adx_entitypermission_webrole array contains expected role GUIDs.
secondary.notes: Confirms the data is set correctly but doesn't prove the portal has picked it up (cache may be stale).

doNotUse.description: Query mspp_entitypermission_webroleset — this shows intersection records exist but the portal IGNORES these. Not a valid verification.
doNotUse.reason: Portal reads from powerpagecomponent content JSON, not intersection table.

doNotUse2.description: GET mspp_entitypermissions({id})/mspp_entitypermission_webrole — always returns 0 results due to platform bug.
doNotUse2.reason: Known platform limitation. N:N navigation on this relationship is broken.

knownFailures.symptom: 403 Forbidden on /_api/{entitySet} even though mspp_entitypermission exists
knownFailures.cause: powerpagecomponent content JSON missing adx_entitypermission_webrole array
knownFailures.fix: PATCH content JSON to include role GUIDs

knownFailures.symptom: Raw PATCH to mspp_entitypermissions fails with 'key not present in dictionary' (0x80040224)
knownFailures.cause: mspp_entitypermissions is a virtual table that doesn't support standard PATCH
knownFailures.fix: Use Update-Record helper (handles encoding) OR PATCH the underlying powerpagecomponent content JSON

knownFailures.cause: Platform bug — navigation property broken on this N:N relationship
knownFailures.fix: Query mspp_entitypermission_webroleset directly to verify intersection records, but note this is NOT what the portal uses

knownFailures.symptom: $ref POST succeeds silently but portal still returns 403
knownFailures.cause: $ref creates intersection table records but portal reads content JSON instead
knownFailures.fix: Always PATCH the powerpagecomponent content JSON — $ref alone is insufficient

knownFailures.symptom: Deleting one permission unlinks ALL permissions
knownFailures.cause: N:N relationships stored in a way that modifying permission table can cascade
knownFailures.fix: After ANY permission delete/recreate, re-run full role-linking for ALL permissions and clear cache

updatePermissionFlags.description: Change CRUD flags on an existing table permission.

steps.description: GET the powerpagecomponent record, parse content JSON
Modify the flags in the parsed JSON, serialize back, PATCH
steps.notes: Keys in content JSON are: read, write, create, delete, append, appendto (NO mspp_ prefix)

fallbacks.method: Update-Record -setName 'mspp_entitypermissions' — the helper function handles encoding that raw PATCH cannot
fallbacks.notes: This updates the mspp_ virtual table but may not sync to content JSON. Always verify content JSON afterward.

primary.method: Read back content JSON and verify flags match expected values

knownFailures.symptom: Raw Invoke-RestMethod -Method PATCH on mspp_entitypermissions fails
knownFailures.fix: Use Update-Record helper or PATCH powerpagecomponent content JSON directly

createSiteSetting.description: Create a Web API site setting (enabled + fields) for a table.

steps.description: Query for existing setting to ensure idempotency
steps.api: Get-Records -setName 'powerpagecomponents' -query "?$filter=_powerpagesiteid_value eq {siteId} and powerpagecomponenttype eq 9 and name eq '{settingName}'"

steps.description: Create Webapi/{table}/enabled setting
steps.notes: content must be JSON string with value key: {"value":"true"}, NOT just 'true'

steps.description: Create Webapi/{table}/fields setting
steps.notes: Use * for all fields, or comma-separated column names for specific fields

primary.method: Query powerpagecomponents for the setting and verify content
primary.api: Get-Records with filter on name and type=9

knownFailures.symptom: 400 Bad Request on site setting creation with 'value' as a top-level field
knownFailures.cause: powerpagecomponents does not have a 'value' column — the value goes inside the content JSON
knownFailures.fix: Use content = '{"value":"true"}' not a separate value field

deployFlow.description: Deploy or update a Power Automate cloud flow via the Dataverse workflows table.

steps.description: Push flow definition with Compose actions replacing connection-dependent actions. This creates the flow shell.
steps.api: PATCH workflows({flowId}) with clientdata containing placeholder actions
steps.notes: NEVER overwrite the trigger — only replace actions.

steps.description: MANUAL STEP: User opens flow in Power Automate designer, adds one action per connector type. This establishes the connection references.
steps.requires: Human interaction in Power Automate designer

steps.description: Read back the connection format from the flow, then push full definition with real actions using the proven connection format.
steps.api: PATCH workflows({flowId}) clientdata with full actions

fallbacks.method: User must open flow in designer and Save or Discard, then retry PATCH

primary.method: Query workflows table for statecode=1 (activated) and verify clientdata contains expected actions

knownFailures.cause: Someone edited the flow in designer without saving
knownFailures.fix: User must open flow and Save or Discard — no API workaround exists

knownFailures.symptom: Connection references have no connections after solution import
knownFailures.cause: Solution import copies connectionreferences without connectionid values
knownFailures.fix: User opens flow in designer to fix connections, OR swap connectionReferenceLogicalName to existing refs

knownFailures.symptom: Word Online field mapping rejected by API
knownFailures.cause: Fields use dynamicFileSchema/{contentControlId} — requires designer for initial setup
knownFailures.fix: Have user map fields in designer first, then read back the proven format

deploySPA.description: Build and deploy the DCFG React SPA to Power Pages.

steps.description: Build the Vite React app
steps.notes: spaRoot is environment-specific — read from desired-state.json

steps.description: Upload compiled assets to Power Pages
steps.notes: Uses pac CLI auth — ensure correct auth profile is selected

steps.description: Clear portal cache so new assets are served
steps.notes: Must be called from authenticated session. Can be done via browser or Playwright.

steps.description: Give operator the portal URL and cache clear URL for verification
steps.notes: Always provide these after deploy — feedback rule

fallbacks.trigger: pac pages upload targets wrong site
fallbacks.method: Delete .powerpages-site/.portalconfig/manifest.yml, re-run pac pages download with correct --webSiteId, then upload again

primary.method: Navigate to portal URL in browser, verify SPA loads and shows current version

knownFailures.symptom: pac pages upload deploys to wrong site
knownFailures.cause: Local manifest.yml locked to incorrect site from prior deploy or solution import
knownFailures.fix: Delete manifest, pac pages download with --webSiteId {correctId}, then upload

knownFailures.symptom: SPA loads but shows old version after deploy

promoteEnvironment.description: Promote solution from test to stage/prod.

primary.method: PAC solution export + import + post-import cleanup

steps.description: Export solution from source environment
Switch pac auth to target environment
Import solution to target
Delete orphan powerpagesites records created by import
steps.api: Query powerpagesites, delete any that aren't the real site
steps.notes: Solution import creates duplicate site records. These MUST be cleaned up before SPA deploy.

steps.description: Check all table permission powerpagecomponent content JSONs still have adx_entitypermission_webrole arrays
steps.notes: Solution import can reset content JSON. Always verify.

steps.description: Run deploySPA procedure against target environment
Clear portal cache on target

primary.method: Navigate to target portal, verify SPA loads, test one /_api/ call

knownFailures.cause: Solution contains powerpagesites references from source environment
knownFailures.fix: Delete all orphan site records, keep only the real one

knownFailures.symptom: All permissions lose role links after import
knownFailures.cause: Solution import can reset powerpagecomponent content JSON, dropping adx_entitypermission_webrole arrays
knownFailures.fix: Re-run permission role-linking script against all tables

monitorHealth.description: Run a Nora monitoring cycle — check audit logs, document requests, flow health.

steps.description: Parse output for: stuck requests (>10min processing), inactive flows, error patterns in audit log
Nora can auto-fix dcfg_document_requests status ONLY when output is verified in both Dataverse AND SharePoint
steps.notes: Read-only by default. Auto-fix only for verified completions.

steps.description: Write unresolvable issues to dcfg_brain_insights for operator review

primary.method: Check Nora output for 'All systems monitored' message and 12 active flows

knownFailures.symptom: Nora fails to write insight (400 Bad Request)
knownFailures.cause: dcfg_brain_insights schema mismatch or missing required fields
knownFailures.fix: Check required columns on dcfg_brain_insight table

clearPortalCache.description: Clear portal cache after any metadata change.

primary.method: Hit cache clear URL from authenticated session
primary.notes: MUST be done from an authenticated session. Changes to permissions, site settings, web roles are NOT visible until cache is cleared.

primary.method: Navigate to portal, verify changes are reflected

createTable.description: Create a new Dataverse custom table via API.

steps.description: Build table metadata hashtable with IsPrimaryName=true on primary attribute
steps.notes: Primary attribute MUST have IsPrimaryName=$true. Do NOT use 'PrimaryAttribute' as a top-level field — use 'Attributes' array.
Requires MetadataOperations.ps1 dot-sourced. Table metadata propagation takes 3-5 seconds.

steps.description: Query EntityDefinitions to get the auto-generated EntitySetName
steps.notes: Wait 3-5 seconds after creation before querying — propagation delay.

knownFailures.cause: Using Attributes array without IsPrimaryName=$true on the primary name attribute
knownFailures.fix: Add IsPrimaryName=$true to the primary attribute in the Attributes array

knownFailures.cause: Using 'PrimaryAttribute' as a top-level property instead of putting the attribute in the Attributes array
knownFailures.fix: Use Attributes array with IsPrimaryName=$true, not a separate PrimaryAttribute field

knownFailures.symptom: 404 on EntityDefinitions query immediately after table creation
knownFailures.fix: Wait 3-5 seconds before querying the new table metadata

enhancedDataModel.description: DCFG uses Enhanced Data Model. Classic adx_* tables do not exist for portal metadata.

platformRules.portalCacheRule: ALL metadata changes (permissions, settings, roles) require cache clear before portal reflects them.
platformRules.softDeleteRule: Always soft delete (dcfg_active_flag=false), never hard delete.
platformRules.bothEnvironmentsRule: Always deploy to BOTH test and stage environments.
platformRules.trailingSlashRule: Connect() MUST have trailing slash on org URL.
platformRules.appendBothSidesRule: Append AND AppendTo must be set on BOTH sides of any relationship.
